title: Prove native-history action coupling and reduce the QQ16 comparison
body:
## Result and construction decision

#4167 left a concrete obstruction to pricing QQ16 against fair B/B*: closed Ordinary engines retain different free-slot orders, and native parking serializes those slot identities. This package supplies a **source-bound phased allocator/codec action theorem**, with actual fitted and recursive-return evidence. No queue reset, new engine or physical tape is introduced. It also proves successful coefficient-payload action opacity at fixed complete geometry, so the retained changed-core calls do not require separate numerical body prices.

This is one **Class C substantial enabling context result**, not another caller installation, parking comparison or ownership exchange. It removes the body/history residual on **all 510,646 Gamma retained occurrences**, including the complete 493,097 Gamma later suffix. It does **not** establish QQ16's total incremental sign. The fixed recovery mechanism stops here until the remaining necessary comparison is priced.

## Native history and actual evidence

The relation pairs active logical numerical handles, aliases, values, widths and heads, then pairs free stacks by position. On recursive suspension it saves the parent map, permits a different active child map, and restores the original parent Word objects from their encoded slot records. One fixed global permutation is neither required nor asserted. Sorted parking changes record order, but equal per-bank record extents and the literal codec's bit-shape law preserve R/W/unit-move counts.

All **490 actual parking transitions** are checked for binary-counterpart completeness and collapse to **360 action-shape classes**. Missing-counterpart and bit-dependent-movement controls reject. Actual legal source allocations/frees followed by park, child reuse and restore produce different slot labels but identical action triples `(1273,460,1168)`; the child-excluded complete park/restore bill is `(1179,428,1068)`.

The genuine fitted Ordinary discriminator reaches five different entry queues, including both native runtime arenas, through completed fallback/fitted histories. Both identical target calls use **79,543,744 reads; 23,380,814 writes; 82,873,286 unit moves**. An additional complement of the nonconstant payload has the same action counts. These are finite observations, not the universal proof. The reduced declared grammar uses `execute_plan`, not production `select` admission. All six arenas are inventoried; the remainder arena is unused in this zero-remainder fixture.

A separate actual width-four native root reaches its first real width-two child return. Its independent child endpoint, original parent slots/values/heads, saved PC/mode/root, borrowed input and paused roles pass. The parent program is deliberately not completed; explicit disposal is separately metered. The inherited #4167 reduced prefix/both-bridge-legs/suffix fixture is replayed in a separate authenticated process.

The exact BLANK-versus-LEFT output correction is one write. Actual complex calls have matched warm-erased Ordinary markers. A new whole-epoch proof prices original controller first use at **703 writes once**; B and D each retain one original child backend, so those potentials cancel globally. Empty live sets still do not prove absence of escaped PhysicalWord references; source ownership remains explicit.

## Complete incremental consequence

With the source-bound descriptor equality and successful-payload proof, all retained complete C bodies can cancel. Their caller headers still cost **14,298,088 Gamma extra actions**. Let E_r(g) be the complete original external C call at its actual geometry and named marker class, including descendants once. Then:

```
T_D - T_B = Delta_N + Delta_shell + 14298088 Gamma
              + 368 Gamma E_1(g) - 16 Gamma E_8(g).
```

Delta_N retains acquisition/compiler work, all producer/service nonchild arithmetic and bank movement, publication/disposal, constructors and final cleanup. Delta_shell retains unmatched child preparation/return protocols. The service descriptor compiler recovers the same per-owner unused rows U as the producer; rank alone is not used to aggregate E_1. Unrelated upper-bound subtraction is not performed.

Frozen D versus stronger B* additionally owes B*'s already proved return saving. A fair both-adopt equation is stated only for a separately implemented compatible D*, not silently credited to frozen D. The earlier whole-bank and generic parking savings remain credited exactly once. Finite-control tariffs and historical per-role backing remain separate; equal source actions are not equal Python runtime or equal space.

The actual Ordinary invocation count is zero for one-column monomials, otherwise `outer_rows*(4*early+12*late)`. Root callbacks are not reset sites. The signed full-bank group-volume increase is `(281593/816) Gamma B_bank`, labelled a geometric diagnostic rather than the total action difference. No wider decoder/recovery search is justified while E_1/E_8 and the complete nonchild/shell prices remain unpriced.
